versions.subject: Merge PR #5813 from @swachchhanda000 - Add New AMSI Tampering Rules
versions.detection:
selection_key:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script\Settings'
        - 'AmsiEnable'
selection_reg_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_reg_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'add'
selection_powershell_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_powershell_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Set-ItemProperty'
        - 'New-ItemProperty'
        - 'sp '
condition: selection_key and (all of selection_powershell_* or all of selection_reg_*)
versions.spl: CommandLine="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Script\\Settings*" CommandLine="*AmsiEnable*" (Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*Set-ItemProperty*", "*New-ItemProperty*", "*sp *")) OR (Image="*\\reg.exe" OR OriginalFileName="reg.exe" CommandLine="*add*")
